title: Penalties in the 2004 Regulations
rule: A breach of the Regulations is an offence punished as the Act prescribes, and materials found are confiscated. Where the Act has no specific penalty, a general penalty applies.
penalty: General penalty: fine up to TSh 500,000, or up to 2 years in prison, or both.
flag: Act s. 107(5) and Regulations 2019 reg 23 allow only 6 months. Confirm which limit applies.
